status_definitions.READY WITH QUALIFIER: The result can be reported when the stated interpretation boundary is retained.
status_definitions.READY WITH PROTOCOL NOTE: Direct comparisons must use the common splits described in the registry.
status_definitions.READY WITH SCOPE LIMIT: The experiment is valid for its measured retrospective outcome only.

flower_primary_window.policy: Each model sees only its stated historical window. Ensemble weight, global calibration, and plant random-effect prior are selected from 2023 only.

mixture_validation_designs.rolling_origin: The model and all learned link evidence precede the held-out calendar year.
mixture_validation_designs.leave_one_study_out: No interaction labels from the held-out study enter CatBoost or two-tower training; earlier local timing supports remain available for the decision.

rows.question: Which flowering model best estimates later-year weekly flowering probability?
rows.model_scope: Seasonal, generalized linear, boosted, neural, transformer, and calibrated ensemble candidates
rows.manuscript_use: Internal model comparison only. Do not describe 2024-2025 as an untouched final test.

rows.question: Does the flowering approach retain value on an independent source?
rows.evaluation_cohort: 42,294 weekly rows from 42 sites and 342 plants
rows.model_scope: Seasonal reference, CatBoost, FT-Transformer, global ensemble, hierarchical ensemble
rows.statistical_evidence: Site-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals use all 42 NEON sites and 2,000 replicates. Model uses training-median soil imputation because NEON soil covariates are unavailable.
rows.manuscript_use: External cross-source evaluation. Describe it as partial-covariate, not a full deployment simulation.

rows.question: Which seasonal activity model best allocates probability to later observed bee weeks?
rows.train_validation_test: Training eligibility and model fitting 2015-2022 | validation 2023 | test 2024-2025
rows.evaluation_cohort: 281 training-eligible species appearing later and 163,616 scored later occurrence records. Training eligible pool equals 288 species.
rows.model_scope: Raw weekly histogram, circular kernel, cyclic spline, spatial partial pooling, trait-family partial pooling
rows.statistical_evidence: Paired species bootstrap confidence intervals use the verified 281-species cohort, 10,000 replicates, and a fixed random seed.
rows.manuscript_use: Use the corrected point metrics and verified 281-species confidence intervals.

rows.question: Can methods rank documented links under held-event and novelty conditions?
rows.train_validation_test: Shared V16 split protocol. Common core splits are held event, unseen pair, unseen plant, unseen bee, and future year.
rows.evaluation_cohort: All four output groups contain the same future_year, held_event, unseen_bee, unseen_pair, unseen_plant core splits. Example held-event split contains 8,669 candidate rows and 359 events.
rows.model_scope: Strict evidence, degree heuristic, CatBoost, two-tower neural, compact and rich GraphSAGE, compact and rich HGT
rows.statistical_evidence: Study-unit bootstrap intervals are available for strict evidence, heuristic, CatBoost, two-tower, rich GraphSAGE, and rich HGT.
rows.manuscript_use: Use the common core splits for direct family comparison. Do not use the stale parent progress file as evidence of incompleteness because rich-GNN progress confirms all 10 splits completed.

rows.question: Do integrated seasonal-support mixtures improve future observed plant-bee overlap over baselines?
rows.train_validation_test: Rolling-origin years and leave-one-study-out evaluations. Each held year or study is excluded from learned link information.
rows.evaluation_cohort: 23 site keys. Rolling-origin years 2002, 2003, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017. Leave-one-study-out studies 11. Mixture sizes 3, 5, and 7.
rows.model_scope: Random mean, strict documented network, CatBoost-supported links, two-tower-supported links
rows.statistical_evidence: Paired decision bootstrap comparisons available. The result summary records 23 paired decisions for the reported comparisons.
rows.manuscript_use: Supports retrospective observed seasonal overlap, not field benefit, bee health, abundance, crop pollination, or yield.
